title: The Journey of One Speck of Dust
hook: This speck of dust is about to cross an ocean and feed a rainforest.
script: This speck of dust is about to cross an ocean and feed a rainforest. It begins as mud on a lake bed in Chad that vanished long ago. Then the wind lifts it high above the Sahara. So where do 27 million tonnes of dust go every year? West, for about a week, over nothing but open Atlantic. A week later, a storm gathers over the Amazon. And the rain drags it down onto the canopy. So what does one speck of dust give a forest? The soil there has almost no phosphorus, and this speck is exactly what the trees were missing. One speck at a time, a desert feeds a forest.
